import base64, re

with open\('/tmp/OpenDyslexic-Regular.otf', 'rb'\) as f:
    font_b64 = base64.b64encode\(f.read\(\)\).decode\('ascii'\)

with open\('/workspace/src/vim_tutorial/styling.css', 'r'\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

# Replace the broken @font-face with the correct one
new_face = \(
    "@font-face {\\n"
    "  font-family: 'OpenDyslexic';\\n"
    "  src: url\('data:font/opentype;base64," + font_b64 + "'\) format\('opentype'\);\\n"
    "  font-weight: normal;\\n"
    "  font-style: normal;\\n"
    "}"
\)

content = re.sub\(
    r"@font-face \\{[^}]*font-family: 'OpenDyslexic'[^}]*\\}",
    new_face,
    content,
    flags=re.DOTALL
\)

with open\('/workspace/src/vim_tutorial/styling.css', 'w'\) as f:
    f.write\(content\)

print\("Done. CSS size:", len\(content\), "bytes"\)
print\("Font b64 length:", len\(font_b64\)\)
# Verify it looks correct
idx = content.find\("data:font/opentype;base64,"\)
print\("Data URI prefix found:", idx > 0\)
print\("First 60 chars of b64:", font_b64[:60]\)
EOF)
